02First UI

The first interface turns the concept into an isometric brain office: six SpongeBob workers, memory cabinets, desks, a filing panel, and a timeline for following a memory's story.

VISIBLE IN THIS SNAPSHOT

  • Isometric brain office and SpongeBob workers.
  • Individual, team, and organization cabinets.
  • Memory/activity panel and retrace timeline.
  • Remember, retrieve, evaluate, update, and forget controls.

IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY

This milestone is a scripted scene with browser-local memory history. It does not establish live NemoClaw, Switchyard, Crusoe, SQL persistence, or measured memory-evaluation results.
